Mexico · Made to take along

Chicken & cheese burritos

Mexican-inspired wholemeal wraps with paprika-cumin chicken, brown rice, peppers, onion, cheddar and salsa. No beans. One portion is two small burritos.

  • ⏱ 30 min with cooked rice
  • 🍽 2 portions
  • 🔥 605 kcal / portion*
Cook step by step →

Ingredients

Makes 2 portions

  • 4 wholemeal wraps (about 45 g each; 2 per portion)
  • 200 graw skinless chicken breast
  • 150 gcooked brown rice (75 g per portion)
  • 200 gbell pepper, before trimming
  • 80 gred onion, before peeling
  • 40 ggrated cheddar
  • 10 mlcanola oil
  • 2 gground paprika (about 1 tsp per 2 portions)
  • 1 gground cumin (about ½ tsp per 2 portions)
  • 40 gmild tomato salsa

Before you start

Equipment

Knife, separate raw-chicken board, bowl, non-stick pan or air fryer; saucepan/rice cooker if making rice. Microwave optional.

Allergens

Wheat/gluten and milk. Check wraps, cheese and salsa for other allergens.

Make it yours

Use a mild salsa. Any colour of bell pepper works. A smaller amount of cheese can be used, but displayed nutrition and cost refer to the listed quantities.

Method

  1. Choose your rice route

    Already cookedDefault

    • Use rice cooled promptly, refrigerated and cooked within the last 24 hours. It must not have been reheated.
    • Keep chilled until step 5. Reheat once and eat now. For future meal prep, choose fresh rice.

    Stovetop

    • Start with about 25 g dry rice per portion. Rinse; follow the packet’s water ratio and cooking time.
    • Weigh out 75 g cooked rice per portion. Cool extra rice promptly. Start filling near the end of cooking.

    Rice cooker

    • Rinse rice. Use the cooker’s cup, brown-rice water guide and minimum batch size.
    • Run the full brown-rice cycle and rest. Fluff; weigh out 75 g cooked rice per portion.
    • Cool extra rice promptly. Allow extra time for the full cooker cycle.
    What it should look likeTender grains; no hard centre.

  2. Prepare vegetables & cheese

    • Wash pepper; remove stalk and seeds. Peel onion. Slice both into 5 mm strips; shorten long strips.
    • Grate cheese and refrigerate separately. Keep fingertips tucked while cutting.
    What it should look likeEven, short vegetable strips; grated cheese kept separate.

  3. Slice & season the chicken

    • On a separate board, slice chicken into 1 cm-thick, 3–4 cm-long strips. Do not rinse it.
    • Mix once with prepared vegetables and all the oil, paprika and cumin.
    • Wash hands, board and knife. The whole mixture now needs cooking; use clean utensils afterwards.
    What it should look likeChicken and vegetables lightly coated with spices.

  4. Cook the chicken filling

    PanDefault

    • Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the seasoned mixture in an uncrowded layer.
    • Cook 8–12 minutes, turning often. Check from 8 minutes; lower heat if spices scorch.
    • Work in batches. Transfer cooked filling to a clean bowl.

    Air fryer

    • Preheat to 200°C. Add seasoned filling in a shallow, uncrowded layer.
    • Cook about 15 minutes; turn at 5 and 10 minutes. Check thick chicken pieces before serving.
    • Cook in batches if needed; keep waiting raw batches refrigerated.
    What it should look likeCut several thick strips: steaming-hot centre, no pink meat, clear juices. If unsure, cook longer. Vegetables should be tender, with browned edges.

  5. Warm rice & soften the wraps

    MicrowaveDefault

    • For eating now: put chilled rice in a vented microwave-safe container with a splash of water. Heat in short bursts, stirring until steaming throughout.
    • Warm wraps separately following the packet. No foil in the microwave.
    • Reheat rice once only; skip reheating freshly hot rice. For later meals, skip assembly and follow Meal prep.

    Stovetop

    • Heat chilled rice in a covered saucepan with a splash of water. Stir until steaming throughout.
    • Warm wraps separately in a dry pan until flexible.
    • Reheat rice once only; skip reheating freshly hot rice. For later meals, skip assembly and follow Meal prep.
    What it should look likeRice steaming throughout; wraps soft enough to fold.

  6. Fill with chicken & cheese

    • Make two small burritos per portion. Divide rice, chicken, vegetables, cheese and salsa evenly between wraps.
    • Place filling in the centre; leave edges clear. Keep excess liquid out. Serve any excess filling alongside.
    What it should look likeA compact strip of filling with clear edges for folding.

  7. Fold, tuck & roll

    • Fold both sides inward.
    • Fold the near edge over the filling and tuck snugly.
    • Roll away from you; rest seam-side down.
    What it should look likeClosed ends, seam underneath, no tears.

  8. Toast lightly & take along

    Toast in panDefault

    • Use already cooked, hot filling. Toast seam-side down in a dry pan over medium heat.
    • Cook 1–2 minutes per side; turn gently. Eat now, or follow Meal prep for chilled transport.

    Keep it soft

    • Skip toasting. Rest seam-side down and eat while freshly hot.
    • For a later packed lunch, use promptly chilled components and an insulated bag with an ice pack.
    What it should look likeLight golden patches, secure seam and softened cheese.

Meal prep and storage

Prep components

For future meals, use the fresh-rice route. Cool the cooked rice and filling separately in shallow containers; keep wraps, cheese and salsa separate. Skip warming and toasting today. The already-cooked-rice quick route is for eating immediately.

Cool & store

Cool rice promptly, ideally within one hour, and refrigerate at 4°C or below. Use within 24 hours of the rice’s original cooking time. Freeze portions for later promptly after cooling. Never reset the storage clock by adding rice to a burrito.

Reheat & assemble

Thaw frozen components in the fridge. Reheat only one meal at a time until rice and chicken are steaming hot throughout, stirring to remove cold spots. Reheat only once. Warm the wrap, then add cheese and salsa, fold and eat.

Take it along

For a cold packed lunch, assemble from promptly chilled components and keep the burritos cold in an insulated bag with an ice pack; refrigerate on arrival. Foil keeps the shape but does not provide safe cold storage. Remove all foil before microwaving.
